# camsync

Compact LLM context index for this repository. Last Updated: 2026-11-25.

camsync is a browser-based vertical-video capture and production studio, a tool for MADFAM's own
production work: an iPhone opens a web page that captures its camera, sends a live view to a control
panel on a Mac over the local network, and records the full-quality master, uploaded to the Mac in
one-second chunks. The studio runs on a Mac on a local network and is never deployed. The repository
also holds the landing for camsync.madfam.io: designed through the impeccable process and live, unindexed.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human overview and status.
- `PRODUCT.md` — known facts and questions open for the owner.
- `docs/REPO_BOUNDARY.md` — what may and may not live in this public repository.
- `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` — the landing's deployment contract (live since 2026-11-25).
- `DESIGN.md` — the landing's design system, recorded from the build.

## Where things are

- `studio/server.mjs` — local relay: signalling (HTTP long-poll), phone status, chunked master upload.
- `studio/public/` — `cam.html` (phone), `control.html` (Mac panel), `view.html` (live view), `shared.js`.
- `site/server/` — the landing's dependency-free Node server and its tests.
- `site/web/` — the landing's template, dictionary (es, en), 404, styles, icon.
- `infra/k8s/production/`, `enclii.yaml`, `.github/workflows/landing.yml` — the landing's deployment.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.

- [docs/NAMING.md](docs/NAMING.md): camsync is a codename; the brand search and the names set aside
- [docs/POSITIONING.md](docs/POSITIONING.md): what camsync is today and where it is meant to go
